title: ADR-015: shadcn/ui component adoption across provider sidebar, diff chips, spec input, settings, toasts, states, command palette

done: src/components/ui/ contains shadcn-generated Button, Card, Dialog, Tabs, Accordion, ToggleGroup, ScrollArea, Tooltip, Select, Input, Label, Sonner

steps.description: Replace hand-rolled collapsible in src/components/sidebar/ProviderSidebar.jsx with shadcn Accordion + ScrollArea. Each provider group becomes an AccordionItem. Preserve existing click-to-load behavior. Tooltips on provider logos use shadcn Tooltip. ARIA + keyboard nav come free from Radix.
steps.done_condition: sidebar renders with Accordion; keyboard arrow nav works; no regressions to provider click-load

steps.description: Replace diff filter chips in src/components/diff/DiffSummary.jsx with shadcn ToggleGroup type='multiple'. Selected filters drive existing filter state. Keep count badges per chip.
steps.done_condition: filter chips use ToggleGroup; multi-select filtering still works; keyboard roving tabindex functional

steps.description: Refactor src/components/diff/SpecInput.jsx input-mode selector (file / URL / paste) to shadcn Tabs. TabsContent per mode wraps existing editor/URL-field/drop-zone components. Default tab = file.
steps.done_condition: three tabs render; switching preserves input content per tab; editor overlay (ADR-007) still aligned

steps.description: Sweep src/pages/settings/* forms: replace native <input>, <select>, <label> with shadcn Input, Select, Label. Wire with react-hook-form + shadcn Form wrapper for consistent validation. Preserve existing validation rules (registry URL, API key format).
steps.done_condition: all settings forms use shadcn Form primitives; submit + validation behavior unchanged

steps.description: Consolidate toast/alert surfaces on sonner (already installed). Remove ad-hoc alert divs. Add <Toaster /> once in App.jsx. Replace window.alert calls with toast.error / toast.success.
steps.done_condition: grep for `window.alert|alert\(` in src/components,src/pages returns zero; all user-facing notifications go through sonner

steps.description: Create src/components/ui/states/{EmptyState,LoadingState,ErrorState}.jsx. Each accepts { title, description, actions, icon } and renders using ADR-014 tokens (t-h2, t-body, t-meta, shadow-e1). Export from src/components/ui/states/index.js.
steps.done_condition: three wrapper components exported; storybook-style manual render in DiffViewer shows correct layout

steps.description: Add command palette: src/components/command/CommandPalette.jsx using cmdk + shadcn Dialog. Global ⌘K / Ctrl+K opens. Commands: Go to Diff, Go to Guide, Go to Settings, Load Provider (submenu), Run Diff, Export Guide. Commands fire existing navigation/actions.
steps.done_condition: ⌘K opens palette; typing filters commands; Enter executes; Esc closes

steps.description: Enforce import discipline: run `grep -r '@radix-ui/' src/components src/pages --include='*.jsx' --include='*.tsx'` and confirm only files under src/components/ui import from @radix-ui. Any violating feature component must re-import from the src/components/ui wrapper.
Run `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, `hex analyze .`. No primary adapter should import from another adapter. Composition-root untouched.
